 is a 51 year-old non-hispanic white female. Patient has a history of part-time employment (finding), normal pregnancy, blighted ovum, limited social contact (finding), not in labor force (finding), full-time employment (finding), viral sinusitis (disorder), sprain of wrist, stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is married. Patient is an active smoker and is an alcoholic.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a high socioeconomic background.
 Patient has completed some college courses.
Patient currently has NO INSURANCE.

# Allergies
No Known Allergies.

# Medications
